developments.headline: Carney unveils $6.6B 'Buy Canadian' defence industrial strategy
developments.summary: Prime Minister Carney announced a Defence Industrial Strategy promising $6.6 billion investment, 125,000 new jobs over 10 years, and plans to increase Canadian firms' share of defence contracts from 30% to 70%. The strategy aims to reduce dependence on US suppliers and includes creation of Defence Investment Agency and Bureau of Research, Engineering and Advanced Leadership.

story_clusters.headline: Carney unveils $6.6B 'Buy Canadian' defence industrial strategy to reduce US reliance
story_clusters.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney announced a new Defence Industrial Strategy promising $6.6 billion in investment, 125,000 new jobs over 10 years, and plans to increase Canadian firms' share of defence contracts from 30% to 70%. The strategy aims to reduce dependence on US suppliers.

story_clusters.headline: Third Conservative MP Matt Jeneroux crosses floor to join Carney's Liberals
story_clusters.summary: Edmonton MP Matt Jeneroux became the third Conservative MP in recent months to defect to the Liberal Party, bringing the Liberals within three seats of a majority government. Jeneroux cited Carney's 'ambitious agenda' as his motivation.

story_clusters.headline: Poilievre distances himself from MP Jivani's 'anti-American hissy fit' comments
story_clusters.summary: Conservative Leader Pierre Poilievre was forced to distance himself from Ontario MP Jamil Jivani's comments to Breitbart News that Canada was undermining its US relationship with an 'anti-American hissy fit' over tariffs. The controversy raised questions about Poilievre's caucus control.

story_clusters.headline: Carney appoints Janice Charette as chief US trade negotiator for CUSMA review
story_clusters.summary: Prime Minister Carney named former Privy Council clerk Janice Charette as Canada's chief trade negotiator with the United States ahead of the Canada-US-Mexico Agreement review. Conservatives criticized the appointment given Charette's role during the Freedom Convoy.

story_clusters.headline: Carney proposes 'bridge' between EU and CPTPP trade blocs amid US tensions
story_clusters.summary: Prime Minister Carney confirmed Canada is spearheading conversations to build a trading bloc between the European Union and CPTPP members, positioning Canada as a broker amid US trade tensions. Carney said 'Canada can play a role' in these efforts.

story_clusters.headline: Bank of Canada orders restaurant tip manager XTM to halt payment activities
story_clusters.summary: The Bank of Canada issued a temporary order halting XTM Inc.'s retail payment operations after allegations the company failed to safeguard client funds, causing a 'significant shortfall' in restaurant worker tips across BC.

story_clusters.headline: NDP leadership candidates face off in final debate before March vote
story_clusters.summary: Five NDP leadership candidates held their second and final official debate in New Westminster, BC. The candidates focused on rebuilding the party, with only Tony McQuail saying he's aiming for the Prime Minister's Office while others emphasized party rebuilding.

story_clusters.headline: Carney government shifts advertising budget toward patriotic messaging
story_clusters.summary: The federal government reallocated its advertising spending after Carney became Prime Minister, shifting priorities to patriotic and economic messages and purchasing expensive television airtime during major sporting events.

story_clusters.headline: Carney announces planned visit to India to deepen trade relations
story_clusters.summary: Prime Minister Carney will travel to India next week for the first official visit in years, with India's envoy saying a comprehensive trade deal could be signed within a year as Canada seeks to diversify its alliances beyond the US.

story_clusters.headline: Charles Milliard acclaimed as new Quebec Liberal Party leader
story_clusters.summary: Charles Milliard was acclaimed as the new leader of the Quebec Liberal Party after no other eligible candidates came forward, taking over from Pablo Rodriguez who resigned in December amid internal party turmoil.

story_clusters.headline: CSIS identifies anti-feminist ideology as emerging national security concern
story_clusters.summary: Senior officials at the Canadian Security Intelligence Service said anti-feminist ideology is becoming 'increasingly relevant' to Canada's national security landscape and may lead to radicalization and violent extremism, though it doesn't yet rise to a direct threat level.

story_clusters.headline: Bloc Québécois MP Simon-Pierre Savard-Tremblay assaulted in Brussels
story_clusters.summary: Bloc Québécois MP Simon-Pierre Savard-Tremblay reported being mugged and pepper-sprayed by three men while in Brussels for a NATO Parliamentary Assembly meeting. The incident occurred as he was walking in the Belgian capital.
